title: Rewrite signing and ids per D4
description: Ch 11-12 (04-content-storage), Ch 33-36 (10-crypto). One detached SigningRecord as JWS; protected header carries a Corundum type member (domain separation); kid = DID URL / IPNS key binding. id = raw CID of stored bytes; never re-serialize (normative); no in-object id. Delete Canonical JSON/NFKC/timestamp/null rules and Ch 34 embedded-signature procedure. Ed25519 verification profile (strict RFC 8032 vs ZIP-215; S<L; canonical A/R). Downgrade rule: ratchet, judge at signing time. Historical validity needs external time anchor (manifest chain), not signer's own ts. PQ names: ML-DSA (FIPS 204), SLH-DSA (FIPS 205), FN-DSA; pin params. Delete invented RSA/DSA/SHA-1 sunset history. Unify ed25519 vs ed25519-v1 and base64 vs base64url.
close_reason: Ch 33-36 rewritten: exact-bytes raw CIDs, detached/attached JWS, strict Ed25519 profile, inclusion-based historical validity, pruned registry. Downstream notes on esol.3/7/9/11/13/14.
